node.statement: Assume P is nonvanishing and e<=e_ca. The permitted upstream lemma lem-compcb-corner-algebra states that S_P, with the compressed product dot and inherited involution, is an extended (C_ca e)-C*-algebra. By the registered definition of extended epsilon-C*-algebra, this means that for every n>=1 the amplified algebra M_n tensor S_P, with the entrywise-amplified compressed product and involution, is a (C_ca e)-C*-algebra. Applying its registered lower C*-axiom to Z gives ||Z^dagger dot Z|| >= (1-C_ca e)||Z||^2. Thus K_sq=C_ca and e_sq=e_ca prove the claimed all-n estimate on the nonvanishing branch; no comparison with the ambient product Z^dagger Z is used.
